----Petitioners  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2.
Sayri Devi D/o Shri Sukharam Suthar, W/o Shri Hanuman  Lal, R/o Nimbol, Tehsil Jaitaran, District Pali, Rajasthan.
----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Harish Jangid For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mohd. Javed Gouri, PP  Mr. M.S. Shekhawat, for complainant
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN MONGA Order (Oral) 14/08/2024 1.
Quashing of an FIR No.360/2022 dated 25.07.2022 lodged at Police Bilara, District Jodhpur, for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC is sought herein.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that during the pendency of these proceedings, the parties have entered into compromise and a compromise-deed dated 11.07.2024 has been executed and the respondent No.2-complainant is not inclined to press charges against the petitioners and proceed further in the [2024:RJ-JD:33961] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-5409/2024] matter.

Learned counsel places reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr.
[(2012) 10 SCC 303].

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent No.2-complainant submits that the petitioners are her brothers and now she does not want to press charges against the petitioners and concurs the factum of compromise and submits that she has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor also concurs with the fact of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, he has no objection if the FIR in question is quashed.

5. In the premise, applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to avoid undue hardship to the parties in dispute for mutual good relations and societal peace.

5. Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed and the FIR No.360/2022 dated 25.07.2022 lodged at Police Station Bilara, District Jodhpur, and all consequential proceedings against the petitioners are hereby quashed.
6. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.

(ARUN MONGA),J 86-skm/-
